exposure: Group art therapy for fear of childbirth (FOC)
cohort: 30 women volunteers in their third trimester of pregnancy with moderate levels of fear of childbirth, attending a public women's hospital.
finding: Group art therapy significantly reduced fear of childbirth, anxiety, and depressive symptoms in pregnant women compared to group psychoeducation.
mod_finding: Most women in the art therapy group (n=12) had natural deliveries, while those in the psychoeducation group had more C-sections (n=10).
